blocks.text: NEW YORK — Taylor Swift is back in action. Did you miss her? On Wednesday, Sept. 23, less than one day after announcing a new song, “Patient Zero” — her first since her starry wedding this summer — Swift has revealed “The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore,” an extended version of her 2025 album with four new tracks: The aforementioned single “Patient Zero” as well as “Cleveland!” “Pink Clouding” and “Babylon.” The new collection arrives Friday, Sept. 25. “About a year ago, you guys did a truly unfathomable thing.
